'''Ahkar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] he traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Ahkar greeted [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] who departed with [[Miot Dengd]] and [[Theron Shan]] on a mission to take down a [[Star Fortress]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Ahkar appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in the Alliance base on Odessen and begins the Star Fortress missions for the Republic players.
